name: Jellyseerr Requests
author: claymaver
description: Adds a real Home-screen tab backed by your Jellyseerr instance - search, browse trending, and submit requests (with per-season picking) without leaving Jellyfin.

vars.name: Jellyseerr URL
vars.description: Base URL of your Jellyseerr instance, e.g. https://jellyseerr.example.com

vars.name: Jellyseerr API Key
vars.description: Found in Jellyseerr under Settings -> General -> API Key. Stays server-side, never sent to the browser.
